book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: سرنديب جزيرة كبيرة، خضرا، وفيها جبل عالي بنص السما.
sentences.en: Serendib is a big island, green, with a high mountain in the middle of the sky.

words.caphi_raw: J a z ii r a

sentences.ar: بيقولوا إن آدم نزل عليه لما طلع من الجنة.
sentences.en: They say Adam came down onto it when he left Paradise.

sentences.ar: وفيها كل إشي: ياقوت، ولؤلؤ، وفيلة، وقرفة.
sentences.en: And it has everything: rubies, pearls, elephants, cinnamon.

words.caphi_raw: f i y a l a

sentences.en: And its king was the greatest king I had seen.
He rides an elephant, with a thousand men around him.

words.caphi_raw: y i r k a b

sentences.en: And before him one calling: this is the king!

sentences.ar: وورا الملك، واحد تاني بينادي: وهاد بيموت زي أي واحد.
sentences.en: And behind the king, another calling: and he dies like anyone.

words.caphi_raw: h aa dh , h aa D.

sentences.en: So the king does not forget.

sentences.ar: أخدوني للملك، وحكيت له قصتي، وقصة الجبل والنهر.
sentences.en: They took me to the king, and I told him my story, and the story of the mountain and the river.
And I showed him what I had brought on the raft.
And I gave him the best of the pearls and the ambergris, as a gift.

words.caphi_raw: 3 a t. i y y e
h a d i y y e

sentences.en: He said: where are you from?

sentences.ar: قلت: من بغداد، من بلاد الخليفة هارون الرشيد.
sentences.en: I said: from Baghdad, from the lands of the Caliph Harun al-Rashid.

words.caphi_raw: kh a l ii f e

sentences.en: He said: I have heard of him.
They say he is a just king.
I said: he is the justest king in the world.

sentences.ar: وضحك الملك، وقال: كل واحد بيقول هيك عن ملكه.
sentences.en: And the king laughed, and said: everyone says that of his king.
I lived in Serendib for months, the king's guest.

sentences.ar: ورحت أشوف الجبل اللي نزل عليه آدم.
sentences.en: And I went to see the mountain Adam came down onto.

sentences.ar: وشفت بالسوق ياقوت زي البيض، وفيلة بتشتغل زي الخدم.
sentences.en: And I saw in the market rubies like eggs, and elephants working like servants.

sentences.ar: وكل يوم كنت أتعلم إشي جديد.
sentences.en: And every day I learned something new.

words.caphi_raw: 2 i t 3 a l l a m

sentences.ar: بس كل ليلة، كنت أحلم ببغداد.
sentences.en: But every night, I dreamed of Baghdad.
Of the Tigris, the mosques, the smell of bread in the morning.

sentences.ar: وفهمت إشي: الغريب بيحب البلد اللي بيشوفها.
sentences.en: And I understood something: the stranger loves the country he sees.
And he longs for the country he left.

sentences.ar: ورحت عند الملك، وقلت: يا ملك، بدي أرجع.
sentences.en: And I went to the king, and said: my king, I want to go home.
He said: why?
You have everything here.
I said: I do not have Baghdad.
And the king was silent, and then said: fine.

sentences.en: But I want a service from you.
And I said: at your command.

sentences.ar: وما كنت أعرف إن هالخدمة رح تخليني أرجع للبحر مرة تانية.
sentences.en: And I did not know that this service would send me back to sea one more time.
